source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Language, ViolenceGamesANOMALITHReleases 10/28/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLanguage, ViolenceLoadingView DLCAnomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPSRemain yourself. Live on.Anomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPSSurvive a world crawling with Anomalies.The girl faces her fate, gun in hand—──────────■ STORY──────────Japan, the year 20██.Anomaly Zones suddenly appear without any sign.In search of her friend who went missing in an Anomaly Zone, 17 year old Reona Minazuki becomes a Diver for the government-backed Anomaly Zone Countermeasures Office.On her first Dive, as countless other Divers fall victim to the Zone, a strange power awakens within her.The sole survivor, she heads deep into the abyss of Anomaly Zones.Her friend's disappearance, the origin of Anomaly Zones, and the mystery of her powers— When all of it is finally revealed, what will she see—?──────────■ SYSTEM──────────Dive, Retrieve, ReturnWhile exploring Anomaly Zones, Reona has no choice but to engage strange creatures called "Anomalies" in combat.Manage your ammunition and carefully select what to retrieve as you make your way to extraction."【Anomaly Zone】 Combat and Dives - Investigation of Anomalous Spaces that Transcend the Laws of NatureAn apartment complex with inverted gravity, a twisted, writhing hallway, a shopping street that endlessly multiplies—Explore Anomaly Zones where various anomalous phenomena have occurred. - Gun Action and InventoryDestroy all Anomalies you encounter and carefully choose the right weapon for each battle.Items discovered on Dives can be brought back to Base and utilized. - Anomalization SkillsReona Minazuki can make use of 12 unique powers.They support gunfights, and can sometimes serve as powerful game-changers.【Base】 Replenish and Enhance - Gun Customization and ArtifactsUtilize attachments to customize each firearm and tailor them to various combat styles.Equip Artifacts retrieved from Anomaly Zones to improve your stats.Choose wisely when selecting equipment and ammo as you prepare for Dives. - Change into a Variety of CostumesGears are separated into nine parts, with each costume affecting Reona's stats.Outward appearance can be changed without affecting stats, making it possible to go on Dives in your favorite fashion. - Collect Info on Anomaly ZonesDefeat Anomalies to view Dive Reports detailing their ecology.Learn detailed information on the backgrounds and relationships of other characters through side missions.──────────■ CREATORS──────────Scenario: Romeo TanakaCharacter Design: MONComposer: Yuka KitamuraSoftware description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):【Pre-order Bonus】 - "Lost Property Control Organization" Collab Mission - "Lost Property Control Organization" Collab Outfit - "Lost Property Control Organization" Collab Drone Skin "T-6407J" - "Red Causal Punk" Outfit - Consumable Item Set "Anomaly Zone Diver Set (B)" - Consumable Item Set "Development Material Set"*Pre-order bonus is available for customers who purchase by 23:59 (JST) on October 28, 2026.*Pre-order bonuses may be distributed at a later date.Related tagsActionShootingChoose your difficultyOnline scoreboardsPlay for the fastest timeSurvivalThird-personVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 14.6 GBNintendo Switch 2: 14.6 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
